description: The siege prevented menstrual pads and tampons entering alongside fresh water, soap and toilet paper. Women have torn edges off shelter tents and pieces of clothing to use as pads.
energy_note: Cutting up the tent you are sleeping in.

description: Women turned to norethisterone, normally prescribed for painful or heavy periods, to suppress menstruation entirely. Side effects include irregular bleeding, nausea, cycle changes, dizziness and mood swings. Local sources report even the pills have become scarce.
money_note: Per course, where obtainable at all.
energy_note: Switching your body off because there is no alternative.

aspect: The stated reason is dignity, not convenience
description: A Gaza City psychologist described more women turning to the pills to avoid the embarrassment and shame caused by the lack of hygiene, privacy and health products - not to avoid the period itself.

aspect: The health consequences of the alternative
description: Unsanitary materials and prolonged product use cause urinary tract infections, bacterial vaginosis, menorrhagia and abnormal discharge - conditions that then need the health system that is not there.
energy_note: An infection caused by the lack of a pad.

aspect: It is a recognised rights question, and recognition changes nothing yet
description: Analysts invoke CEDAW's provision on adequate living conditions in relation to water and sanitation; the UN Special Rapporteur on water and sanitation has described water being used as a weapon of war in Gaza.
energy_note: Named at the UN, unresolved on the ground.

aspect: This one does not appear in war reporting at all
description: Of everything in this dataset it is among the most universal - it affects roughly half the displaced population every month - and among the least written about, because it is the part people will not describe afterwards.
energy_note: Half the population, monthly, and almost no coverage.

aspect: EXAMPLE - what the tents are being cut up for

energy_note: Cutting up the tent you sleep in, because there is nothing else.
